title: Operator norm is at most the Hilbert-Schmidt norm, and the Hilbert-Schmidt norm is continuous
statement: For all natural numbers m, k >= 0: every continuous linear map A : R^m -> R^k satisfies ||A|| <= hsNorm(A), where ||A|| is the operator norm and hsNorm(A) = (sum_{i<m} ||A e_i||^2)^(1/2) is the Hilbert-Schmidt norm (e_i the standard orthonormal basis of R^m). Moreover the map A -> hsNorm(A) is continuous on the space L(R^m, R^k) of continuous linear maps with its operator-norm topology.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ), (∀ A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k, ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A) ∧ Continuous (fun A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k => hsNorm A)
